sources.title: llms.txt files let hackers trick AI agents into malware | Cybernews
sources.snippet: Researchers found 237 unclaimed packages and domains in company llms.txt instruction files. Attackers can claim those names and make AI agents install malicious code from official-looking instructions. Researchers say their test package ran inside a Fortune 500 company in under four minutes. A real campaign impersonated Clerk by registering a package name referenced in its llms.txt file.
